title: Unit Economics dashboard: layout + filter interactions (time/model/region/tier) and drilldown navigation
creator: Marissa Cole
description:
Goal
Define the v1 Console internal Unit Economics dashboard layout, filter bar behaviors, and drilldown navigation patterns. This ticket focuses on the page-level UX (structure + interaction rules) so Console engineering can implement consistently and Finance can rely on repeatable views.

Context
This dashboard’s primary metric is blended $/1M output tokens with drilldowns by model (incl. version/quantization profile where available), region, and customer tier.

References
- PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/internal-unit-economics-dashboard-prd.json
- UX spec (draft companion): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/unit-economics-dashboard-drilldown-ux-spec.json
- Metric dictionary: sources/confluence/eng-platform/dashboards-and-alerts/unit-economics-dashboard-metrics-and-definitions.json
- API contract sketch (eng draft): sources/google_drive/shared_drives/engineering/console-and-tooling/unit-economics-api-contract-sketch.json

Deliverables
1) Final page layout spec (header + filter bar + KPI row + time series + Top-N tables)
2) Filter interaction rules (defaults, persistence, multi-select behavior, validation)
3) Drilldown navigation spec (from Top-N and chart to detail pages / breakdown views)
4) Empty/error/loading state copy + guidance

Layout (v1)
A. Page header
- Title: “Unit Economics (Internal)”
- Subtitle: “Blended cost per 1M output tokens” + last updated timestamp (from API).
- Right side: “Data quality” indicator (simple: OK / Degraded) with tooltip linking to runbook (eng-owned; this ticket defines placement only).

B. Filter bar (sticky)
Filters are always visible and stick to top when scrolling. Filters update the entire page (KPI + chart + Top-N tables).

Order (left → right)
1) Time range (required)
2) Model (optional)
3) Region (optional)
4) Customer tier (optional)
5) Advanced (collapsed) – contains Streaming flag + Quantization profile (only if data coverage available)
6) Compare (toggle)
7) Reset / Share

C. KPI row
- Primary KPI: Blended $/1M output tokens
- Secondary: Output tokens, Total attributed cost, Cache hit rate, Batching efficiency (placeholders if not yet wired; should show “—” with tooltip “Not available in v1 data feed”).

D. Main chart
- Time series of blended $/1M output tokens.
- Hover shows numerator/denominator and coverage note if data quality degraded.

E. Top-N tables (below chart)
- Top models by blended $/1M output tokens
- Top regions by blended $/1M output tokens
- Top customer tiers by blended $/1M output tokens
Each table supports sorting, and row click drills into a breakdown view.

Filter interaction rules
1) Time range
- Default: “Last 7 days” for Engineering/Product; Finance can use “Month to date” via saved URL.
- Presets: Last 24h, Last 7d, Last 30d, Week to date, Month to date, Quarter to date, Custom.
- Custom: date picker with timezone displayed (default: viewer locale). We must show timezone to avoid day-boundary confusion.
- Granularity: auto (hourly for <= 7d, daily for > 7d) with option to force daily.

2) Model
- Multi-select dropdown with search.
- Display label: marketing-friendly model name; value used in URL/API is canonical model_id (per ENG-8422).
- Include “All models” state. When multiple selected, show “3 models” chip and list on hover.
- If a selected model becomes unavailable (e.g., renamed), show chip with “Unknown model (legacy)” and allow removal.

3) Region
- Multi-select dropdown with search.
- Display label: canonical region label (“us-east”, “eu-west”) with tooltip showing raw/legacy mapping if available.
- Include “Unknown/Unmapped” option when data includes null/unknown region. Default behavior: include Unknown in “All regions” but surface as a row in Top regions.

4) Customer tier
- Single-select in v1 to reduce combinatorics and confusion (All / Self-serve / Dedicated / Private / Enterprise).
- If Engineering confirms tier derivation supports multi-select without blowing up API caching keys, we can revisit in v1.1.

5) Advanced filters (collapsed by default)
- Streaming: All / Streaming only / Non-streaming only
- Quantization profile: All / list of allowed profiles (guarded values). If coverage < 80% for selected time range, show “Quantization profile (limited coverage)” and tooltip.

6) Compare toggle
- When enabled, user selects comparison window: “Previous period” (same length) or “Custom”.
- UI adds a dotted comparison line in chart and a delta % on KPI.
- Compare affects chart + KPI only (not Top-N tables) in v1 to keep tables interpretable.

7) Apply model
- Immediate apply on selection change (no “Apply” button), with debounce (300–500ms) to avoid spamming the API when typing.
- Show skeleton loading for KPI + chart. Tables can show inline loading rows.

8) Persistence + shareability
- All filter state is encoded in the URL query string so Finance can bookmark/share.
- Provide “Share link” button that copies URL.
- Provide “Reset” that returns to defaults.

Drilldown navigation
- Clicking a Top-N row drills into a “Breakdown view” anchored on that dimension:
  - Example: click a model row → opens Model breakdown: chart + a secondary table of regions/tiers for that model.
  - Breadcrumbs: Unit Economics → Models → [Model Name]
  - Drilldown should preserve time range and other filters.
- Clicking a chart point opens a side panel (not a new page) with:
  - time bucket (hour/day)
  - blended $/1M output tokens
  - output tokens
  - cost
  - coverage notes (missing dims, delayed ingest)
This avoids building a full “inspect event” UI while still aiding investigation.

Empty / error / degraded states
- No data (valid filters): “No data for this selection.” Provide quick actions: Clear Model, Clear Region, Reset filters.
- Partial data (missing hours): show banner “Data incomplete for selected range” with last complete timestamp and link to runbook.
- API error: inline error + “Retry”. Do not show stale cached values without an explicit “stale” label.

Open questions (flagged to Product/Eng)
- Should tier be single-select (v1) vs multi-select? (Eng noted caching keys and confusion risk.)
- Should “Unknown/Unmapped region” be included by default in “All regions”? (Proposed yes, but must be explicit in Top regions.)
- Are we comfortable showing “blended” without a big disclaimer? (Recommend tooltip next to metric name: definition + link to metric dictionary.)

Acceptance criteria
- Filter bar spec is unambiguous (default values, selection rules, URL persistence).
- Drilldown navigation is consistent across chart + tables with breadcrumbs and preserved filters.
- Eng review comments addressed (see comments section) and design is implementable with the current API contract direction.

Implementation notes for Console Engineering (non-blocking)
- Keep filter state in URL; allow internal feature flag gating separately.
- Prefer a single query endpoint for the page with parallel calls for chart + tables (as per ENG-8427) but ensure the UI behaves predictably if one section fails.
comments: 2025-01-30 — Marissa Cole: Creating design ticket to lock down filter behavior + layout for v1. Biggest risk is Finance misreading comparisons if filters aren’t explicit/persisted. Please prioritize URL shareability + clear defaults.

2025-02-01 — Alicia Perez: Posted first pass wireframe notes (based on dashboard-wireframes-v0). Proposal: sticky filter bar, immediate-apply filters, and drilldown as subpages with breadcrumbs. Open question: tier multi-select vs single-select.

2025-02-03 — Chloe Martin: Engineering feedback: please avoid multi-select tier in v1. It explodes API cache keys and complicates top-N queries. Recommend single-select tier + multi-select model/region only. Also +1 on URL-encoded filters.

2025-02-04 — Felix Schneider: For time range, we need to be explicit about timezone. We already saw day-boundary mismatches in early aggregation views. Suggest showing timezone next to the date picker and using viewer locale by default.

2025-02-04 — Nora Ahmed: Drilldown request: clicking a chart point should NOT navigate away; prefer a side panel with the time bucket breakdown and any missing-dimension warnings. Navigating away makes it hard to compare trends.
2025-02-05 — Alicia Perez: Updated spec: tier set to single-select in v1; added timezone label and comparison toggle scope limited to KPI+chart. Added drilldown side panel on chart point click.

2025-02-06 — Jada Williams: Noted that region normalization will include Unknown/Unmapped. Please specify default behavior so we don’t accidentally drop Unknown rows. Suggest include in “All regions” but surface explicitly in tables (agree).
2025-02-07 — Alicia Perez: Added degraded/partial data states and guidance: never show stale values without labeling. Added share link button to copy URL with filter params.

2025-02-10 — Sean Gallagher: SRE ask: include a placeholder for “Data quality: OK/Degraded” near title with tooltip linking runbook. We’ll wire it later; just need consistent placement and state design.
2025-02-12 — Alicia Perez: Final pass: placed Data quality indicator in header (right side). Added banners for incomplete data and API error behaviors.
2025-02-18 — Marissa Cole: Marking done. This spec is good enough for ENG-8428 implementation. Follow-ups tracked in DES-312 (tables/top-N) and DES-319 (visualization guidelines/rounding).
